Sort a list of points by a plane

**Panel:** Comma → Point · **Nickname:** `RalSort`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `Pt` | Point | List |  | Points to be sorted |
| Plane | `Pl` | Plane | Item | `Plane.WorldXY` | Plane to sort points |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Point | `P` | Point | List | Sorted points |
| Indices | `i` | Integer | List | Indices of sorted points |
